blocks.text: Fraser Heights Homes for Sale | Surrey BC MLS

parts.t: Fraser Heights sits on the bluff in the northeast corner of Surrey, above the Fraser River and next to Highway 1 and the Port Mann. It's a family area of mostly detached homes from the 1980s onward, with a few newer pockets. Here's what's for sale in Fraser Heights right now.
I've been a REALTOR® since 2015 and I rank in the top 1% of Fraser Valley Realtors. Most of my work is in South Surrey and White Rock, and I bring the same checklist to North Surrey. Read my
Fraser Heights neighbourhood guide
or compare all
North Surrey homes for sale
Written by
Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®

Fraser Heights Recreation Centre is at 10588 160 Street. Surrey Bend Regional Park, run by Metro Vancouver, is on the river edge to the east, and Fraser Heights Park and Erma Stephenson Park are closer to home.

Fraser Heights Secondary is on 108 Avenue. Elementary schools in and around the area include Dogwood, Erma Stephenson, Fraser Wood and Bothwell. Catchments are by address, so use the Surrey Schools School Locator.
Buses 337 and 338 serve the area. There's no library inside Fraser Heights; Guildford and Port Kells are the nearest branches. Highway 1 is right there, which is the big draw for many commuters.
The City approved the Abbey Ridge plan for the eastern part of the area in February 2017. If you're near it, read what it shows for your street. My
land use plans
page has the links.

Fraser Heights often suits families who want a larger detached home, a short drive to Highway 1, and schools close by. Many homes have the space for a suite or a home office, and the river trails at Surrey Bend are a real bonus.
It may suit you less if you'd like to walk to shops and transit. Most errands here mean a drive to Guildford or across the bridge.

Buyers here often compare one Fraser Heights home against three others on nearby streets, so condition and presentation matter. I'll show you which updates are worth doing before you list and which ones buyers won't pay for. Then we'll set a price based on recent sales nearby, not a guess.
Send me the streets you like and your budget, and I'll set up an alert so you see new listings the day they come out.

blocks.text: What secondary school serves Fraser Heights?

parts.t: Fraser Heights Secondary on 108 Avenue serves much of the area. Check the School Locator for the address.

blocks.text: Is there a library in Fraser Heights?

parts.t: No. The closest branches are Guildford and Port Kells.

blocks.text: What is the Abbey Ridge plan?

parts.t: A City of Surrey plan approved in February 2017 for part of Fraser Heights.
Routes 337 and 338.

blocks.text: Are there newer homes in Fraser Heights?

parts.t: Most homes date from the 1980s onward, with some newer pockets. Ask about the age of the roof, windows and mechanical systems on any listing.

blocks.text: Is Fraser Heights close to Highway 1?

parts.t: Yes. It's right beside Highway 1 and the Port Mann Bridge, which makes the commute easy for many owners.
